name: Duke DI
author: matheusbrasil
description: White-box 12AU7 preamp/DI after the Noble DI: two starved-heater triode stages, an interactive passive FMV tone stack (Bass/Treble) derived by nodal analysis, switchable treble-dependent low-cut (~82-154 Hz), White cathode follower, optional DI-transformer path. Clean, high-headroom, even-order voiced.

params.name: Gain
params.explanation: Input drive into the first 12AU7. Low = clean and open; high = starved-tube compression and even-order grit. A deliberate addition - the circuit has no gain control.

params.name: Bass
params.explanation: Low end of the interactive passive FMV stack (BASS A250k rheostat). Noon is the natural voiced curve; up adds weight. Interacts with Treble.

params.name: Treble
params.explanation: High end of the interactive passive FMV stack (TREBLE A250k, C6 270p). Noon is the natural voiced curve; up adds air. Interacts with Bass and sets the low-cut corner.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Output level. 80 is unity gain, 100 is +3.5 dB.

params.name: LoCut
params.explanation: Low-cut (the ROLLOFF switch): C8 4n7 into R18 220k, corner ~82-154 Hz depending on Treble. Tames sub-bass rumble.

params.name: XFMR
params.explanation: DI-transformer path (JT-DB-EPC). OFF is the transformerless 1/4-inch output; ON adds the XLR transformer weight and low-end core saturation.
